div.div: 8 اِزْدِرَامٌ The act of swallowing [a thing]: (S, K:) mentioned in the S in art. زدرم or زردم [accord. to different copies]; (TA;) and in the K, as an art. by itself; the reason whereof is not apparent; for it appears to be of the measure اِفْتِعَالٌ; not اِفْعِلَالٌ. (MF, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
